defs.def: to arrange for an event, etc. to take place at a later time or date 延迟；延期；展缓noun

ex.s: Postponing the melting of the glaciers.
They said the letter inside would explain what it was all about, but he had to postpone opening it until 2 o’clock.
ex.t: 他们说里面的信会解释这是怎么回事，但他必须推迟到两点钟才能打开。

ex.s: The trials on patients were likely to be postponed because they did not have sufficient safety data.
ex.t: 对患者的试验可能会被推迟，因为他们没有足够的安全数据。

chunks.cn: 去 延迟 开放的
